intended_outcome: Project the formal Decision 5 iteration-2 verifier/critic result into a valid shared verification ledger without losing fixed-coverage status.
repeatability_reason: Any plan revision that fixes an actionable finding and then re-verifies the same coverage can exercise this projection.

failure_handling.symptom: Projected ledger marks fixed coverage checked and fails validation.
failure_handling.response: Preserve the projection evidence, correct the reusable status projection, and verify through the same controller command.

verification_contract.success_evidence: project-verify-plan-ledger returns VERIFY_PLAN_LEDGER_PROJECTED and the resulting ledger validates.
